tasks.label: Unit tests via script
tasks.command:
cd /media/cyberdave/BIGJ1/Development/Apps/geraet/geraet-ai && .venv/bin/python <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess
r = subprocess.run(
    ['.venv/bin/python', '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/unit/', '--tb=short', '-q', '--timeout=60'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/media/cyberdave/BIGJ1/Development/Apps/geraet/geraet-ai'
)
stdout = r.stdout
stderr = r.stderr

# Write clean files
with open('/tmp/py_out.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(stdout)
with open('/tmp/py_err.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(stderr)
with open('/tmp/py_rc.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(r.returncode))
with open('/tmp/py_tail.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(stdout[-5000:])

# Extract failures section 
fi = stdout.find('FAILURES')
ti = stdout.rfind('=====')
if fi >= 0 and ti > fi:
    with open('/tmp/py_failures.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(stdout[fi:ti+len('==')])
else:
    with open('/tmp/py_failures.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write('NO_FAILURES_SECTION_FOUND')

print(f'Returned={r.returncode}, wrote to /tmp/py_*')
PYEOF
